info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Changes API
Microsoft Azure List The Changes Of A Resource Group Within The Specified Time Range Customer Data Will Always Be Masked

params.name: $startTime
params.description: Specifies the start time of the changes request.

params.name: $endTime
params.description: Specifies the end time of the changes request.

params.name: $skipToken
params.description: A skip token is used to continue retrieving items after an operation returns a partial result. If a previous response contains a nextLink element, the value of the nextLink element will include a skipToken parameter that specifies a starting point to use for subsequent calls.

params.name: $filter
params.description:
Reduces the set of data collected.
This argument is not required. Only accepts 'resourceId' and 'resourceType' and only accepts the following patterns.
- *List changes for a resource type*: $filter=resourceType eq 'microsoft.web/sites'.
- *List changes for multiple resource types:* $filter=resourceType eq 'microsoft.web/sites,microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'.
- *List changes for a resource Id*: $filter=resourceId eq '{resourceId}'.
- *List changes for multiple resource Ids:* $filter=resourceId eq '{resourceId1},{resourceId2}}'.
